$comment: Code words the site prints deliberately that are not part of the
@open-e2ee/signal-protocol-sdk surface. Everything else in an inline
<code> span must exist in the SDK, so an invented symbol fails the build.
Add an entry only when the word is genuinely someone else's API, a
platform constant, another OpenE2EE tool contract, or a file or table
name — never to silence a symbol
that was supposed to be ours. Say whose it is.

$provenance.randomUUID: Web Crypto API, and expo-crypto's re-export of it
$provenance.AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY: expo-secure-store; the value the SDK's vault pins in SIGNAL_PROTOCOL_SECURE_STORE_OPTIONS
$provenance.OPEN_E2EE_RELAY_URL: OpenE2EE CLI generated public deployment configuration
$provenance.NEXT_PUBLIC_: Next.js prefix for an environment variable that client code reads
$provenance.EXPO_PUBLIC_: Expo prefix for an environment variable that client code reads
$provenance.VITE_: Vite prefix for an environment variable that client code reads
